## [1.1.0](https://github.com/srinath1848/nobrokerhood-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-09)

### ✨ New Features

* support NoBrokerHood 3.6.11 and remove notification ads ([e93455e](https://github.com/srinath1848/nobrokerhood-patches/commit/e93455ef2ab5dfd9ae126fb72860643d8c1ee637))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* escape Kotlin class descriptor ([c8d06e0](https://github.com/srinath1848/nobrokerhood-patches/commit/c8d06e04b3c86ad456f2f41653edbf1bf123db09))
* publish NoBrokerHood patches ([8463e6b](https://github.com/srinath1848/nobrokerhood-patches/commit/8463e6b574a5aa4262c59e02b96a23ab2a9a6699))
* retry Gradle distribution downloads ([d635032](https://github.com/srinath1848/nobrokerhood-patches/commit/d6350328138fd78a6f8f4c7b44e60277802070d3))

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide app-bar banners (experimental)
patches.description: Empty app-bar banner entries; may leave a layout placeholder.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide expanded notification images (experimental)
patches.description: Hide large banner images in entry/exit notifications while retaining text (3.6.11).

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide homepage top ads (experimental)
patches.description: Supply an empty top-ad list and disable its loading/expanded state.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide post-approval ad card (experimental)
patches.description: Hide the sponsored card shown after entry approval or pre-approval (3.6.11).
